title: Supply Chain Risk, Trade and Economic Fragility
title_zh: 供应链风险、贸易与经济脆弱性
authors: Juanma Castro-Vincenzi, Adry Gracio, Gaurav Khanna, Nitya Pandalai-Nayar
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study how equilibrium patterns of production, trade, and input sourcing in complex supply chains are shaped by aggregate risk. We develop a quantitative multi-country model with multi-sourcing across stages. We show that sourcing shares equal an input’s expected output elasticity — its expected marginal contribution to output across states of the world. Risk has a positional effect on sourcing and welfare, operating through offsetting cross-stage complementarity and within-stage substitutability; which one dominates is a quantitative question. An increase in a country’s own risk always lowers its welfare; risk elsewhere has ambiguous, sometimes positive, effects through relative prices. We also show analytically that risk attenuates comparative advantage, as countries shift sourcing away from their most productive suppliers. Quantifying the model for 50 countries and 3 production stages, we show that supply-chain complexity lowers volatility for the riskiest countries, and rising Chinese-origin risk reallocates production and lowers welfare unevenly across the chain.
abstract_zh: 本文研究复杂供应链中生产、贸易与投入品采购的均衡模式如何受总体风险影响。我们构建了一个包含多阶段多源采购的定量多国模型。研究表明，采购份额等于投入品的预期产出弹性——即该投入品在全球各状态下对产出的预期边际贡献。风险对采购与福利产生结构性影响，其作用机制通过跨阶段互补性与阶段内替代性的相互抵消实现；何种效应占主导地位属于定量问题。一国自身风险上升始终降低其福利水平；而其他地区的风险则通过相对价格渠道产生模糊影响，有时甚至呈现正向效应。我们通过分析证明，风险会削弱比较优势，促使各国将采购从最具效率的供应商转移。基于覆盖50个国家与3个生产阶段的模型量化分析表明：供应链复杂性降低了高风险国家的波动性，而源自中国的风险上升则导致生产沿供应链非均衡重新配置，并造成福利不均衡下降。

title: Leaning Against the Global Financial Cycle
title_zh: 抵御全球金融周期
authors: Ferrero, Andrea, Habib, Maurizio Michael, Stracca, Livio, Venditti, Fabrizio
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We investigate the impact of institutional quality on shielding emerging economies from the Global Financial Cycle. Our findings indicate that countries with a higher rule of law, characterized by superior contract enforcement and more robust protection of property rights, experience a less severe tightening of domestic financial and macroeconomic conditions when faced with adverse global financial shocks. We explain this outcome through a simplified model that incorporates financial frictions, showing how strong institutions and effective governance alleviate collateral constraints and mitigate the effects of global financial pressures on the domestic economy.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了制度质量在保护新兴经济体免受全球金融周期影响中的作用。研究结果表明，法治水平较高、合同执行更优且产权保护更完善的国家，在面对不利的全球金融冲击时，其国内金融和宏观经济状况的紧缩程度较轻。我们通过一个包含金融摩擦的简化模型解释了这一结果，展示了强有力的制度和有效治理如何缓解抵押品约束，并减轻全球金融压力对国内经济的影响。

title: Is Money Overrated? Misperceived Satisfaction from Income
title_zh: 金钱被高估了吗？收入带来的满足感被误解
authors: Ricardo Perez-Truglia, Rafael Macedo Rubião
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: People often make important choices in pursuit of higher income, but do they place too much weight on income when deciding what path to take? We propose a simple model of misspecified learning in which individuals overestimate the marginal satisfaction from income—the expected effect of an income increase on overall life satisfaction—and therefore give income too much importance in their decisions. Guided by this model, we designed a pre-registered experiment that elicits beliefs about the marginal satisfaction from income and randomly assigns scientific evidence about it. Respondents substantially overestimate the marginal satisfaction from income both for themselves and for others, but especially for themselves. These biases shrink when respondents are exposed to scientific evidence, and the effects persist one month later. To study whether these beliefs matter for behavior, we measure income-versus-non-income trade-offs using job-choice scenarios tailored to each respondent and a real-world decision the respondent is facing. To elicit the latter, we make a methodological contribution: an AI-led interview method that moves beyond static, predefined survey instruments by combining the flexibility of qualitative interviewing with the discipline of closed-ended survey measurement. We find that biased beliefs are consequential: after learning that income matters less for life satisfaction than they initially thought, respondents place less weight on income in their decisions.
abstract_zh: 人们常常为了追求更高收入而做出重要选择，但他们在决策时是否过度看重收入？我们提出了一个简单的错误学习模型，其中个体高估了收入的边际满意度——即收入增长对整体生活满意度的预期影响——因此在决策中赋予收入过高的权重。在该模型指导下，我们设计了一项预注册实验，通过诱导被试对收入边际满意度的信念，并随机分配关于该问题的科学证据。被试显著高估了自身及他人的收入边际满意度，尤其对自身的高估更为严重。当被试接触科学证据后，这些偏差有所缩小，且效果在持续一个月后依然存在。为探究这些信念是否影响行为，我们通过针对每位被试定制的职业选择场景以及其面临的实际决策，衡量收入与非收入之间的权衡。为获取后者，我们做出了一项方法论贡献：采用人工智能引导的访谈方法，该方法结合了定性访谈的灵活性与封闭式调查测量的规范性，突破了静态、预定义的调查工具。研究发现，偏差信念具有显著影响：当被试了解到收入对生活满意度的影响低于其最初预期后，他们在决策中对收入的重视程度有所降低。

title: Short-Term Reversal Persists Globally—If Properly Measured
title_zh: 短期反转在全球范围内持续存在——若测量得当
authors: Jan Stosik, Adam Zaremba
abstract: Short-term reversal appears to have weakened in international equity markets because standard measures mix firm-specific and industry-wide returns. When evaluated relative to industry peers, the reversal persists. Using data from 64 countries, the conventional strategy delivers negligible returns, whereas an industry-adjusted strategy earns 0.53% per month with a Sharpe ratio of 0.74. The effect reflects the reversal of firm-specific shocks masked by persistent industry components. A regret-based signal captures the same industry-relative variation, adding no incremental return. Reversal did not disappear; it was mismeasured.
abstract_zh: 短期反转效应在国际股票市场中似乎有所减弱，这是因为标准指标混淆了公司特定回报与行业整体回报。当以行业同行作为基准进行评估时，反转效应依然存在。基于64个国家的数据，传统策略带来的回报微乎其微，而经行业调整后的策略每月可获得0.53%的收益，夏普比率为0.74。这一效应反映了被持续性行业成分掩盖的公司特定冲击的反转。基于遗憾的信号捕捉到了相同的行业相对变化，但并未带来额外回报。反转效应并未消失，而是被错误衡量了。

title: Enforcing Fair Lending: Evidence from Mortgage Market Litigation
title_zh: 执行公平贷款：来自抵押贷款市场诉讼的证据
authors: Matthew Maury, Michael Suher, Jeffery Y. Zhang
abstract: Does fair lending litigation impact mortgage lender decisions? Using a novel dataset of all fair lending legal actions from 1991 to 2023, we find that it does. In the wake of legal settlements for discrimination against Black borrowers, lenders significantly reduced denial rates for Black applicants. The reductions offset pre-litigation racial disparities in denial rates by litigated banks, relative to those banks' competitors. Origination rates for Black applicants also increased post-litigation. We further observe evidence of a spillover effect on the approval decisions of non-litigated banks operating in the same city as a litigated bank. Altogether, the evidence suggests that the enforcement of fair lending laws is an effective tool to reduce racial discrimination in credit markets.
abstract_zh: 公平贷款诉讼是否影响抵押贷款机构的决策？利用1991年至2023年所有公平贷款法律诉讼的新数据集，我们发现确实存在影响。在针对黑人借款人的歧视性法律和解后，贷款机构显著降低了黑人申请人的拒绝率。与诉讼银行的竞争对手相比，这些拒绝率的下降抵消了诉讼银行在诉讼前存在的种族差异。诉讼后，黑人申请人的贷款发放率也有所上升。我们进一步观察到，在同一城市运营的非诉讼银行的审批决策存在溢出效应。总体而言，证据表明，公平贷款法律的执行是减少信贷市场种族歧视的有效工具。

title: DP21641 Households’ Macroeconomic Beliefs: The Role of Education
title_zh: DP21641 家庭宏观经济信念：教育的作用
authors: Jessica Piccolo, Alessia Russo, Eleonora Granziera, Efrem Castelnuovo, Jessica Piccolo; Alessia Russo; Eleonora Granziera; Efrem Castelnuovo
official: 官方在线 2026-06-18 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We design a novel survey to study how education shapes households’ joint beliefs about inflation, unemployment, and monetary policy transmission. College-educated respondents perceive the inflation-unemployment trade-off and hold views similar to professional forecasters, while less educated respondents favor supply-side narratives. When exposed to hypothetical monetary policy interventions, the more educated update expectations and adjust consumption and saving in line with standard models, whereas the less educated display greater rigidity. This education gradient persists after controlling for information sources, financial literacy, and institutional trust, pointing to differences in abstract reasoning. Open-ended responses are consistent with college-educated households holding mental models aligned with standard macroeconomic theory.
abstract_zh: 我们设计了一项新颖的调查，研究教育如何塑造家庭对通胀、失业及货币政策传导的共同信念。受过大学教育的受访者能够感知通胀与失业之间的权衡关系，其观点与专业预测者相似；而教育程度较低的受访者则更倾向于供给侧叙事。在接触假设性的货币政策干预措施时，受教育程度较高的群体会更新预期，并按照标准模型调整消费与储蓄行为，而受教育程度较低的群体则表现出更强的刚性。这种教育梯度在控制信息来源、金融素养和制度信任等因素后依然存在，表明其源于抽象推理能力的差异。开放式回答的结果与以下结论一致：受过大学教育的家庭所持有的心智模型与标准宏观经济理论相吻合。

title: Liquidity Traps, Prudential Policies and International Spillovers
title_zh: 流动性陷阱、审慎政策与国际溢出效应
authors: Javier Bianchi, Louphou Coulibaly
abstract: We investigate optimal monetary and macroprudential policies in an open economy with aggregate demand externalities and an occasionally binding zero lower bound constraint. Our analysis highlights that the optimal policy balances output stabilization and capital flow management. When macroprudential policy is available, monetary policy stabilizes the output gap. By contrast, when macroprudential policy is not available, monetary policy is used prudentially. However, contrary to a widespread view, raising the interest rate is not necessarily the optimal prudential policy. Finally, we show that international spillovers operate through the world real rate, but macroprudential policies provide insulation from the adverse effects of foreign policies.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在存在总需求外部性和零下限约束偶尔生效的开放经济体中，最优货币政策和宏观审慎政策的制定。我们的分析强调，最优政策需要在产出稳定与资本流动管理之间取得平衡。当宏观审慎政策可用时，货币政策用于稳定产出缺口。相反，当宏观审慎政策不可用时，货币政策被审慎地使用。然而，与普遍观点相反，提高利率并非最优的审慎政策。最后，我们表明国际溢出效应通过世界实际利率传导，但宏观审慎政策能够抵御外国政策的不利影响。

title: Early Life Adversity and Multi-Dimensional Health Consequences in India: Quasi-Causal Evidence from the Longitudinal Ageing Study in India
title_zh: 印度早期生活逆境与多维健康后果：来自印度纵向老龄化研究的准因果证据
authors: Tripathi, Pragya, Goli, Srinivas
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper investigates whether early-life adversity (ELA) affects later-life health in India using nationally representative LASI data and quasi-experimental variation from cohort differences and the Bengal Famine. We estimate probit models, KHB mediation, and GSEM across seven outcomes: underweight, food insufficiency, poor self-rated health, low cognition, depression, ADL, and IADL. ELA shows a monotonic dose-response relationship with all seven outcomes. Education mediates most of the ELA effect on cognition and IADL, while life satisfaction dominates for depression. Direct effects persist, indicating biological scarring. The Bengal Famine produced lasting health deficits, except for IADL where mortality selection dominates. Heterogeneity reveals larger cognitive penalties for women, stronger physical/functional penalties in Central/Eastern India, and wealth buffers underweight but not depression or self-rated health. These findings survive extensive robustness checks (IV-PSM, inverse probability weighting, alternative ELA measures, birth cohort analysis, and machine learning). Results imply that early-life interventions, especially universal education, can substantially reduce later-life health inequalities in India.
abstract_zh: 本文利用印度全国代表性LASI数据，以及基于队列差异和孟加拉饥荒的准实验变异，研究早期逆境（ELA）是否影响印度人群的晚年健康。我们针对七项健康指标（体重过轻、食物不足、自评健康差、认知能力低、抑郁、日常生活活动能力障碍及工具性日常生活活动能力障碍）估计了Probit模型、KHB中介效应分析和广义结构方程模型。结果显示，早期逆境与所有七项指标均呈现单调剂量-反应关系。教育在早期逆境对认知能力和工具性日常生活活动能力的影响中起主要中介作用，而生活满意度在抑郁路径中占主导地位。直接效应持续存在，表明存在生物性疤痕效应。除工具性日常生活活动能力受死亡率选择主导外，孟加拉饥荒造成了持久的健康缺陷。异质性分析揭示：女性面临更大的认知惩罚，印度中部和东部地区承受更强的身体/功能性惩罚，财富能缓冲体重过轻风险，但对抑郁和自评健康无保护作用。上述结论通过了广泛稳健性检验（工具变量-倾向得分匹配、逆概率加权、替代早期逆境测量指标、出生队列分析及机器学习）。研究结果表明，早期干预措施（尤其是普及教育）可显著减少印度晚年健康不平等。

title: Shifting the reference point in environmental regulation: from polluter‐pays to beneficiaries‐compensate
title_zh: 环境规制中的参照点转移：从污染者付费到受益者补偿
authors: Jens Gudmundsson, Jens Leth Hougaard, Erik Ansink
abstract: In many environmental problems, emissions are hard to monitor and abatement costs are privately known. We study how efficient abatement nevertheless can be induced through market‐like arrangements that condition transfers on verifiable abatement rather than on measured emissions. We characterize the transfer schemes that implement efficient abatement in unique dominant strategies and show that a single scheme, the beneficiaries‐compensate transfer scheme, emerges under two distinct characterizations: one based on equilibrium properties and one grounded in classical fairness axioms. Under the beneficiaries‐compensate transfer scheme, each agent compensates others according to the benefits received from their abatement. We illustrate its usefulness in two applications.
abstract_zh: 在许多环境问题中，排放难以监测且减排成本属于私人信息。我们研究如何通过类似市场的安排——即依据可验证的减排量而非实测排放量进行转移支付——仍能实现有效减排。我们刻画了在唯一占优策略下实现有效减排的转移方案，并表明一种单一方案——受益者补偿转移方案——可通过两种不同特征化方式得出：一种基于均衡性质，另一种基于经典公平性公理。在受益者补偿转移方案下，每个参与者根据从他人减排中获得的收益对他人进行补偿。我们通过两个应用案例说明其有效性。

title: The Causal Effect of Parents' Education on Children's Earnings
title_zh: 父母教育对子女收入的因果效应
authors: Sang Yoon (Tim) Lee, Nicolas Roys, Ananth Seshadri
official: 官方在线 2025-09-30 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We present a model of endogenous schooling and earnings to isolate the causal effect of parents' education on children's education and earnings outcomes. The model suggests that parents' education is positively related to children's earnings, but its relationship with children's education is ambiguous. Identification is achieved by comparing the earnings of children with the same length of schooling, whose parents have different lengths of schooling. The model also features heterogeneous preferences for schooling, and is estimated using HRS data. The observed correlation between parents' and children's years of schooling is largely driven by the correlation between parents' schooling and children's unobserved preferences for schooling. This is partly offset by a slightly negative, structural relationship between parents' and children's schooling choices, resulting in an IV coefficient smaller than OLS when exogenously increasing parents' schooling. Nonetheless, an exogenous one-year increase in parents' schooling raises children's lifetime earnings by 2 percent on average.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个内生教育年限与收入模型，以分离父母教育对子女教育及收入结果的因果效应。模型表明，父母教育与子女收入呈正相关，但与子女教育的关系并不明确。通过比较父母教育年限不同但子女受教育年限相同的个体收入，实现了因果识别。该模型还纳入了对教育偏好的异质性，并利用HRS数据进行估计。观察到的父母与子女教育年限的相关性，主要源于父母教育与子女未观测到的教育偏好之间的相关性。这一效应部分被父母与子女教育选择之间微弱的负向结构性关系所抵消，导致当外生提高父母教育年限时，工具变量估计系数小于普通最小二乘法。尽管如此，父母教育年限外生增加一年，仍能使子女终身收入平均提高2%。
